rules: Universe-wide composite rank: 60d trend t-stat, R^2 quality, 63d RS vs SPY, 20d return / 20d vol. Take top 2 names with composite z >= 1.0 AND R^2 >= 0.3 AND RS >= SPY. Stop = 2 ATR. Target = projected 20d move, clipped to [2, 6] ATR. Max hold 30d; early exit when composite z falls below 0.5.
